en: The government office at a border that checks goods entering a country; or the taxes paid on imported goods.
ex: We had to pass through customs at the airport.
我們必須在機場通過海關。

en: What you plan to do; or determined to do something.
ex: He was intent on finishing the project by Friday.
他一心想在星期五前完成專案。

en: A person who publicly supports an idea; or to recommend something publicly.
ex: She advocates stricter controls on pollution.
她主張對污染實施更嚴格的管制。

en: Information, often one-sided or misleading, used to promote a political cause.
ex: The film was used as propaganda during the war.
這部電影在戰爭期間被用作宣傳。

en: A famous person, especially in entertainment or sport; or the state of being famous.
ex: Many celebrities attended the charity event.
許多名人出席了這場慈善活動。

en: The right of a group or person to make their own decisions and govern themselves.
ex: The region was granted greater autonomy last year.
該地區去年獲得了更大的自治權。

en: For fear that something might happen; in order to prevent something.
ex: Write it down lest you forget.
把它寫下來，以免你忘記。

en: The legal right to take care of a child; or the state of being held by police.
ex: The mother was given custody of the children.
母親取得了孩子的監護權。

en: A famous person or thing regarded as a symbol; or a small picture on a computer screen.
ex: Click the icon to open the program.
點擊圖示來開啟程式。

en: To face a difficult situation or person directly; or to meet someone in a hostile way.
ex: She decided to confront her boss about the unfair treatment.
她決定就不公平待遇當面質問老闆。

en: The study of how living things relate to each other and to their environment.
ex: She studies the ecology of coastal wetlands.
她研究沿海濕地的生態。

en: To keep something going over time; or to suffer an injury or loss.
ex: The company cannot sustain such heavy losses for long.
公司無法長期承受如此大的虧損。

en: A young person who is not yet an adult; or childish and immature.
ex: The police arrested two juveniles for vandalism.
警方以破壞公物逮捕了兩名少年。

en: Able to exist or work together without problems.
ex: This printer is compatible with both Windows and Mac.
這台印表機同時相容於 Windows 和 Mac。

en: An official paper that gives information or proof; or to record something in writing or film.
ex: Please bring all the necessary documents with you.
請攜帶所有必要文件。

en: To make something different in some way, or to become different.
ex: The tailor altered the dress to fit her better.
裁縫把那件洋裝改得更合她的身。

en: To combine two or more things so they work together; or to become part of a group.
ex: The school helps new students integrate into the community.
學校協助新生融入社群。

en: A violent physical or verbal attack on someone.
ex: He was charged with assault after the fight.
他在打架後被控傷害罪。

en: An offer of a price, especially at an auction; or an attempt to achieve something.
ex: She made a bid of five thousand dollars for the painting.
她對那幅畫出價五千元。

en: A practice of a play, concert or other event before the real performance.
ex: The actors had a final rehearsal before opening night.
演員在首演夜前進行了最後一次排練。

en: Likely to do something; or exactly right for a situation.
ex: Children are apt to copy what adults do.
孩子容易模仿大人的行為。

en: Covering a large area or including a great deal of detail.
ex: The hurricane caused extensive damage to the coast.
颶風對海岸造成大範圍的破壞。

en: A sign of an illness; or a sign that something bad exists.
ex: A fever is a common symptom of the flu.
發燒是流感的常見症狀。

en: A situation in which there is not enough of something that people need.
ex: The country faces a severe water shortage this summer.
這個國家今年夏天面臨嚴重缺水。

en: A style of cooking, especially of a particular country or restaurant.
ex: The restaurant is famous for its Thai cuisine.
這家餐廳以泰式料理聞名。

en: A band of colors produced when light passes through a prism; or a wide range of things.
ex: The party attracts voters from across the political spectrum.
這個政黨吸引了各政治光譜的選民。

en: A place to live or stay, such as a hotel room; or the process of adjusting to something.
ex: The price includes accommodation and breakfast.
價格包含住宿和早餐。

en: The fact of being present at a place or event; or the number of people who attend.
ex: Attendance at the meeting was lower than expected.
會議的出席人數比預期低。

en: The protection of nature or old things from damage or loss; or careful use of resources.
ex: The group works for the conservation of rainforests.
這個團體致力於保護雨林。

en: A group of signs and symptoms that together show a particular disease or condition.
ex: Doctors identified the syndrome in the early 1980s.
醫生在1980年代初發現了這種症候群。

en: Relating to a large city and the area around it.
ex: Over a million people live in the metropolitan area.
超過一百萬人住在這個都會區。

en: To move downward; or to come from an earlier person or time.
ex: The plane began to descend towards the airport.
飛機開始朝機場下降。

en: To go faster; or to make something happen sooner.
ex: The car accelerated as it left the city.
汽車駛出城市時加速了。

en: The possibility that something will happen in the future; or to search for gold or oil.
ex: The prospect of living abroad excites her.
想到要住在國外讓她興奮不已。

en: The structure of bones inside the body; or the basic framework of something.
ex: The museum has a complete dinosaur skeleton.
博物館有一具完整的恐龍骨骼。

en: A long piece of cloth with a message on it; or a headline across the top of a web page.
ex: Fans waved banners in support of their team.
球迷揮舞著旗幟為球隊加油。

en: A serious promise to do something; or to promise something formally.
ex: The mayor pledged to improve public transport.
市長承諾要改善大眾運輸。

en: A long period of time with little or no rain.
ex: The drought has destroyed most of the crops.
乾旱毀掉了大部分農作物。

en: To say a poem or piece of writing from memory; or to list facts one by one.
ex: The students had to recite a poem in front of the class.
學生們必須在全班面前背誦一首詩。

en: Something you accept as true without proof; or the act of taking on a role or power.
ex: We made the wrong assumption about his age.
我們對他的年齡做出了錯誤的假設。
